name: The End
overview: Scripture reveals that the end times will be marked by significant signs and great tribulation unlike any before, as Jesus explained to His disciples on the Mount of Olives (Matthew 24:21). The gospel must be preached worldwide as a witness to all nations before the end comes (Matthew 24:14), yet the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36). Believers are called to watch and pray continually, remaining faithful and ready to stand before the Son of Man when these events unfold (Luke 21:36). This teaching emphasizes both the certainty and the mystery of the end, encouraging vigilance and trust in Christ’s sovereign timing.
